question: Should this bounded request-stage SSRF fix land now with the documented residual browser-routing gaps, or should merge wait for complete connect-time egress enforcement?
rationale: The patch correctly closes the reported interaction gap, but accepting its explicitly incomplete browser-network boundary is a security-policy choice reserved for the protected security review path.

options.title: Accept bounded protection
options.body: Merge this reviewed interaction fix now and keep complete proxy-based enforcement as separate architecture work.

options.title: Require complete enforcement first
options.body: Pause the PR until redirects, popups, workers, reused sessions, and background traffic are governed at connect time.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded protection
recommendation.body: Merge this reviewed interaction fix now and keep complete proxy-based enforcement as separate architecture work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history shows the strongest ownership signal for this browser security boundary and its interaction guard design.
